newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Reynolds & Reynolds off.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Reynolds & Reynolds off.

text.p: Shares in Reynolds & Reynolds Co fell sharply in pre-opening dealings on Tuesday after the company said it expected its earnings for the current quarter to be below analysts' expectations, traders said.
The stock traded at 15 ahead of the opening, down from Monday's New York Stock Exchange close at 19-3/4.
After the market's close Monday, the company said it expects earnings in its third quarter ending June 30 of $0.21 to $0.25 a share. First Call listed a consensus earnings estimate of $0.33 a share.
The company, a provider of integrated information management systems, said its earnings were being impacted mainly by lower revenues in each of its principal businesses.
Reynolds and Reynolds also said late Monday it signed agreements to buy the assests of two healthcare systems vendors.
In other pre-opening activity, shares in biotechnology company Amgen Inc were trading at 59-13/16, down from Monday's close at 62-1/8, traders said.
Morgan Stanley downgraded its rating on Amgen to outperform from strong buy.
